description: Transactions sent from or to an address, as the explorer indexed them: hash, block, time (UTC), from, to, value (wei and LAX), fee (wei and LAX), status, the called method's name, and transaction types (coin_transfer, contract_call, token_transfer, contract_creation). "direction" is "all" (default), "in" or "out". Results come 50 per page, newest first; pass "next_cursor" from a result as "cursor" to get the next page. "limit" returns fewer items, but a page cut by limit has no next_cursor, so leave limit out when paging through everything. Names, symbols, tags and method names are set by whoever deployed or verified a contract and are wrapped as untrusted.

limit.description: return at most this many items (1-50, default 50)

name: explorer_transactions
title: Address transactions
